vectors.name: 64 code units
vectors.why: The limit is 64 UTF-16 code units.

vectors.name: 65 code units
vectors.why: One code unit over the limit.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.why: A name needs at least one code unit.

vectors.name: tab
vectors.why: Only the space is allowed as white space.

vectors.name: dot
vectors.why: A dot is not a letter, digit, space, - or _.

vectors.name: slash
vectors.why: A slash is not a letter, digit, space, - or _.

vectors.name: CON_
vectors.why: Not a device name, it is what Sanitize makes of CON.

vectors.name: COM0
vectors.why: Only COM1 to COM9 are device names.

vectors.name: combining mark
vectors.why: U+0301 is Mn, not a letter.

vectors.name: superscript two
vectors.why: U+00B2 is No, which Python's str.isalnum accepts and char.IsLetterOrDigit does not.

vectors.name: Roman numeral one
vectors.why: U+2160 is Nl, which Python's str.isalnum accepts and char.IsLetterOrDigit does not.

vectors.name: letter outside the BMP
vectors.why: U+1D400 is two surrogates, and neither is a letter.
